name: io.github.Maarmapa/dashai-mcp
title: dashAI (unofficial)
description: Drive a running dashAI instance from an agent: list datasets, describe components, launch trainings, follow their status and predict. Read-oriented, with no delete tools.

environmentVariables.name: DASHAI_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: URL of the dashAI backend. Defaults to http://localhost:8000.

environmentVariables.name: DASHAI_ALLOW_REMOTE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to allow a non-localhost backend. dashAI's API has no authentication, so pointing this server at a remote host exposes an ML backend with no door on it — read the README before enabling.

environmentVariables.name: DASHAI_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: Seconds to wait per request. Defaults to 30.
